task.title: Consume durable chat notifications and register the per-minute job
task.input: Atomic chat outbox, M5 fixed-job foundation, and existing safe SMTP adapter.
task.output: Fixed chat-notifications job, dedicated SMTP content adapter/stable Message-ID, and real once-per-minute cron; no legacy mail-queue wrapper.
task.accept: 1) Caller/wiring point: real per-minute cron POST /api/admin/cron/operations(jobKey=chat-notifications) -> registry -> durable notification service. Saving then restarting still permits consumption. Reject triggers without Bearer. MessageId-unique outbox items do not multiply on retries. Notifications contain only receipt facts/protected links (E-90, E-94). 2) Atomically claim with leaseOwner/version and CAS status. Old workers cannot overwrite a newer lease. SMTP is outside transactions with a 20s deadline. Interrupt after isolated SMTP acceptance -> UNKNOWN -> bounded at-least-once retry with the same stable Message-ID, at most three attempts with 1m/5m/30m backoff. Explicitly allow actual SMTP duplicates (E-91, E-92). 3) Missing SMTP configuration is DISABLED. Persist actual redacted states for unreachable/temporary rejection/attempt exhaustion and recover from the outbox after restart. body/email/token appear in neither notifications nor logs. Failure cannot retract chat received, and unknown HTTP-trigger outcomes do not trigger again automatically (E-35, E-41, E-93).
